description.value: HMCS Alberni Museum & Memorial is a maritime museum on Vancouver Island dedicated to commemorating HMCS Alberni, a Canadian minesweeper lost during World War II. The museum preserves the memory of the vessel and its crew, making it a site of historical and military significance. Touring cyclists exploring the Port Alberni area may find it a worthwhile cultural stop on the regional route.
